student_learning_goal: I can calculate change for mixed transactions.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can calculate change for mixed transactions.
header.character_watermark: Bea the Bear in the top-right with a calculator and money. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.visual_layout: Four mixed transaction boxes with subtraction.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 mixed-change layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 4 transactions: 1) $1.50 pay $5, 2) $3.25 pay $5, 3) $4.75 pay $5, 4) $7.50 pay $10. Each with subtraction and answer slot.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_MIXED at Part 1: keywords name the mixed transactions calc task.

parts.student_instructions: For 2 changes, show the coin + bill mix.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 coin-bill change layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 2 workspaces: 1) Show $3.50 in coins/bills, 2) Show $0.25 in coins.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_SHOW at Part 2: keywords name the coin-bill show change task.

parts.answer_key: $3.50 = 1 toonie + 1 loonie + 2 quarters (or 3 loonies + 2 quarters); $0.25 = 1 quarter.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 single-mixed layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 'Item $7.25, pay $10.' Below: subtraction workspace and answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_ONE at Part 3: keywords name the mixed change single task.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, calculate change for $14.95 paid $20.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Formative — check borrowing across $/¢.
